subject: microbiology
title: Robertson Cooked Meat Medium and Bacteroides fragilis

steps.tx: **Robertson cooked meat medium** grows anaerobes in minced meat particles whose glutathione and unsaturated fats consume oxygen and hold a low redox floor, beef heart infusion above feeding growth. Saccharolytic clostridia pinken the meat with acid and gas; proteolytic species blacken and digest it with foul odour, bench character included in the result.
steps.say: Meat particles eat the oxygen; pink means sugar fermented, black means protein digested.

left.title: Medium design
points: Cooked meat particles provide reducing conditions

right.title: Growth reads
points: Storage medium for anaerobe stocks historically

steps.tx: **Anaerobic culture workflow** from the morphology module becomes concrete here: cooked meat or thioglycollate as backup broth, blood agar and selective plates (kanamycin vancomycin laked blood, Bacteroides bile aesculin) in jars or chambers, aerotolerance testing, and identification by MALDI, because mixed anaerobic flora forgive no shortcuts.
steps.say: Broth backup, selective plates, aerotolerance, MALDI: the anaerobic assembly line.

nodes.label: Specimen into plates plus cooked meat backup
MALDI and susceptibility for sterile sites

steps.tx: **Bacteroides fragilis** leads non sporing anaerobes: gram negative pleomorphic rods with vacuoles, capsulated, bile tolerant (grows in 20 percent bile), kanamycin resistant, catalase positive often, gut dominant anaerobe turned abscess author (abdomen, pelvis, brain via blood), beta lactamase armed so metronidazole, beta lactam inhibitor combinations and carbapenems anchor therapy.
steps.say: The gut's commonest anaerobe is its abscess king, beta lactamase included.

left.title: Fragilis identity
points: Gram negative rods, pale with vacuoles
Kanamycin resistant, vancomycin resistant (gram negative logic)

steps.tx: **Anaerobic abscess ecology** is polymicrobial synergy: aerobes consume oxygen and lower redox, anaerobes capsule and short chain fatty acids block phagocytes, beta lactamases shield neighbours (indirect pathogenicity), and drainage breaks the architecture antibiotics cannot penetrate. Cultures report the cast; therapy covers the community.
steps.say: Abscesses are neighbourhoods, not single pathogens; drainage evicts what antibiotics besiege.

left.title: Synergy mechanics
points: Capsule and fatty acids impair neutrophils
Abscess wall limits drug and cell entry

steps.tx: **Prevotella and Porphyromonas** (oral black pigmenting anaerobes, hemin pigments) drive dental, sinus, aspiration lung and brain infections, Fusobacterium necrophorum Lemierre's jugular thrombophlebitis after sore throats in adolescents, Peptostreptococcus (now divided genera) in mixed abscesses, Veillonella gram negative cocci as oral markers.
steps.say: Above the diaphragm think oral anaerobes; a sore throat then septic jugular is Lemierre.

left.title: Oral anaerobe map
points: Prevotella melaninogenica group: dental and sinus
Fusobacterium nucleatum: periodontal and Lemierre partner

right.title: Syndrome flags
points: Lemierre: sore throat, neck pain, lung septic emboli
Bite wounds human and animal polymicrobial

steps.tx: **Anaerobe susceptibility** is not routine for every isolate (slow, E test and agar dilution reference), reserved for sterile sites, failures and surveillance because patterns shift (metronidazole resistance rare but reported, carbapenem resistance by cfiA in fragilis, clindamycin resistance common). Empiric confidence is audited by surveys.
steps.say: Test anaerobes from blood and brain, survey the rest; metronidazole complacency gets audited.

left.title: Testing indications
points: Blood, brain and sterile site isolates

steps.tx: **Specimen sins in anaerobes** repeat because they are mortal: swabs dried in air, refrigerated pus, superficial wound swabs over deep tissue, sputum for anaerobic culture (oral flora invalidates), and delays. Laboratories reject sputum anaerobes by policy because the answer would be fiction.
steps.say: Anaerobes die in air and lie on swabs; aspirate deep, transport sealed, arrive fast.

right.title: Rejected
points: Voided urine and stool for anaerobes (specific toxins instead)

steps.tx: **Cooked meat descendants** (chopped meat glucose broth in automated era, thioglycollate in every laboratory) persist because redox insurance is timeless; identification moved to MALDI and sequencing, enrichment logic did not retire. Culture modules age asymmetrically: chemistry endures, names accelerate.
steps.say: The broth is a century old; the names it grows are read in minutes now.

left.title: Enduring chemistry
points: Reducing agents protect oxygen sensitive cells
Saccharolytic and proteolytic reads still taught

right.title: Accelerated names
points: Automated blood culture flagging anaerobes earlier
